chunks.heading: Covered virtual services
chunks.text: Members can see a provider by video for primary care, urgent care and behavioral health through the contracted virtual care vendor. Medicaid members have a $0 copay for telehealth visits.
chunks.embedText: Telehealth Visits | Covered virtual services | Members can see a provider by video for primary care, urgent care and behavioral health through the contracted virtual care vendor. Medicaid members have a $0 copay for telehealth visits.

chunks.heading: How members connect
chunks.text: Members use the virtual care app or website and sign in with their member ID. Interpreter services are available during the video visit at no cost.
chunks.embedText: Telehealth Visits | How members connect | Members use the virtual care app or website and sign in with their member ID. Interpreter services are available during the video visit at no cost.

chunks.heading: Limits
chunks.text: Some services still require an in-person visit, such as physical exams for certain conditions and prescribing of some controlled substances. The virtual provider will refer the member to in-person care when needed.
